title: One plan catalogue in the master database: features, prices, seats, allowances, trial expiry
goal: Define plans once, as data the owner can change, and enforce seat limits and trial expiry everywhere from that one place.
why: Plans are defined six different ways (backend/src/middleware/feature-gate.ts PLAN_DEFAULTS with trial/starter/basic/pro/enterprise; routes/admin.ts PLAN_CATALOG with INR yearly prices and 5/15/100 users; services/ai-pricing.ts allowances; super-admin/src/lib/constants.ts free/starter/pro/enterprise monthly; super-admin tenants/[id]/plan/route.ts seat numbers; landing per-user USD). Seats are never checked on invite (routes/users.ts), trial_ends_at is never read, and trial includes voip_calling (ADR fraud rule says no calling on trials). Pricing structure (per agency vs per user) is not yet approved, so prices must be configuration.
steps: Master 0015: create plans, plan_prices, plan_features, plan_allowances exactly as READINESS-PLAN 4.2 (TEXT dates, REAL amounts, INTEGER booleans, UUIDv7 ids written as literal ids in the seed). Seed: plans trial/basic/pro/enterprise (trial_days 14); plan_prices IN per_agency yearly INR 12000/18000/24000 with included_seats 5/15/100 and is_active 1; the cost model's per_user rows (IN ₹200/300/400 monthly-equivalent billed yearly, min_seats 5; WEST and GULF and SG $12/29/49 min 3; MY_TH $8/19/32; LK_NP_BD $3/5/7 min 5) with is_active 0; plan_features from today's PLAN_DEFAULTS minus voip_calling on trial; plan_allowances from ai-pricing.ts (trial 2000, basic 1000, pro 15000, enterprise 25000 AI credits) plus sms_per_month 0 for all India plans, whatsapp_utility_per_month 300/1000/3000, whatsapp_marketing_per_month 0, email_per_month 2000/10000/30000, otp_per_day 200 per tenant, voip_minutes_per_month 0 (calls come from the balance, R305). Data fix: UPDATE tenants SET plan = 'basic' WHERE plan = 'starter'; plan = 'trial' WHERE plan = 'free'. CHANGE (owner 2026-10-14): seed ONLY per_agency yearly prices as the active pricing (IN: INR 12000/18000/24000 with included_seats 5/15/100); do NOT seed per_user rows as active (omit them, or seed with is_active 0 for reference only).

services/plans/catalogue.ts: getCatalogue(env) (KV cache `plans:v1`, 300 s, invalidated by admin writes), getPlanFeatures(env, plan), getAllowance(env, plan, key), getActivePrice(env, plan, market), seatLimit(env, tenantId) = purchased seats on the subscription when present, else included_seats/max_seats of the active price.

feature-gate.ts: requireFeature and getTenantFeatures read plan_features (overrides in tenant_feature_flags unchanged). Keep exporting PLAN_DEFAULTS only if tests import it; otherwise delete it and update the tests. Unknown plan key -> treat as trial and log once.
ai-pricing.ts/ai-credits.ts: monthly allowance from plan_allowances ai_credits_per_month.

routes/users.ts invite and reactivate (~242-317 and the activate/role endpoints): count active users (is_active = 1, excluding pending invites only if invites do not consume a seat; decide: pending invites DO consume a seat) and refuse with 402 { code: 'SEAT_LIMIT', limit, used } when at the limit.

Trial expiry: the daily job set in cron/dispatch.ts (R105) gets checkTrialExpiry(env): tenants with status trial and trial_ends_at < now -> status expired (KV tenant entry deleted). Login for an expired tenant returns 402 TRIAL_EXPIRED (routes/auth.ts) with the plan list URL; tenant middleware already blocks expired.

routes/admin.ts: GET /admin/plans reads the catalogue (replace PLAN_CATALOG); PUT /admin/plans/:key/prices/:id, PUT /admin/plans/:key/features, PUT /admin/plans/:key/allowances (super admin, audited, invalidates KV).
routes/public.ts: GET /api/v1/public/plans?market=IN returns active public plans with features, active price and allowances (no auth, cached 5 minutes, 60 per minute per IP).
utils/tenant-summary.ts: login summary includes plan key, plan name, seat limit and used seats so the desktop can show them.

Add-on catalogue (master 0015, same migration): table plan_addons (id, key, kind TEXT CHECK kind IN ('extra_seat','ai_credits','sms','whatsapp','otp','call_minutes','email'), market TEXT, currency TEXT, quantity INTEGER, unit_cost REAL (provider cost per unit, NULL for extra_seat and ai_credits), margin_pct REAL DEFAULT 20, price REAL (for extra_seat and ai_credits set by the owner; for communication kinds computed as round_up(quantity * unit_cost * (1 + margin_pct/100)) and stored), is_active, created_at, updated_at). Seed IN rows: extra_seat (price per extra user per year, placeholder 2400 INR, owner to confirm), ai_credits packs (10,000 credits, placeholder price), sms/whatsapp/otp packs with unit_cost from docs/COST-MODEL.md and margin_pct 20.

plan_allowances gets per-plan monthly caps for sms, whatsapp_utility, whatsapp_marketing, otp, email and call_minutes (values from docs/COST-MODEL.md usage profile, small/medium/large mapped to basic/pro/enterprise; owner can edit). Subscriptions get purchased_extra_seats; tenant_usage_caps max_value = plan allowance + active purchased packs for the period.

services/plans/pricing.ts: priceForAddon(env, key, market) recomputes communication pack prices from unit_cost and margin_pct (so a provider price change is one row edit); seatLimit = included_seats + purchased_extra_seats. Admin endpoints: PUT /admin/addons/:id (super admin, audited) and POST /admin/tenants/:id/addons (grant a pack or extra seats; self-serve purchase arrives with R205/R206).

At an allowance limit, the 402 responses (SEAT_LIMIT, ALLOWANCE_EXHAUSTED, AI_QUOTA_EXCEEDED) include { upgradeTo: next plan key or null, addons: [{key, quantity, price, currency}] } so the desktop can offer "upgrade or buy credits".
tests: backend/test/plan-catalogue.test.ts: features come from plan_features (toggle a row, cache invalidated via admin PUT, gate changes); trial has no voip_calling; seat limit: basic with 5 active users -> invite returns 402 SEAT_LIMIT, after deactivating one the invite works; trial_ends_at in the past + daily dispatch -> status expired and login 402 TRIAL_EXPIRED; GET /public/plans?market=IN returns the active per_agency prices; flipping is_active to the per_user rows changes the public response without code changes; starter/free tenants were migrated.
acceptance: `grep -rn "starter\|PLAN_CATALOG" backend/src` finds nothing outside migrations and comments.
Seat limit and trial expiry enforced (tests).
Existing feature-gate tests pass (update them to the catalogue).
Only per-agency prices are active; extra seats raise the seat limit; a communication pack price equals ceil(quantity x unit_cost x 1.20) (test).
A 402 at any cap lists the upgrade target and the purchasable packs (test).
gate: cd backend && npx vitest run   # pass: 0 failed files and passed >= the last merged count (1296 on 2026-10-14)
cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3110 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8797/api/v1 npx playwright test e2e/settings-team.spec.ts e2e/super-admin.spec.ts e2e/ai-settings.spec.ts
goLiveVerify: Owner confirms which plan_prices rows are active (Q2) and trial contents (Q3) before launch.
notes: Before editing read: this batch file, docs/readiness/READINESS-PLAN.md sections 0 and the design note for this area, desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3-4 (executor rules, worktree bootstrap with node_modules junctions; never npm install inside a worktree unless the batch adds a dependency, and then only in the main checkout by the orchestrator).

Backend tests follow the existing pattern (see backend/test/voip-callbacks.test.ts): import env, createExecutionContext, waitOnExecutionContext, applyD1Migrations from cloudflare:test; applyD1Migrations(env.MASTER_DB, env.TEST_MIGRATIONS) in beforeAll; POST /api/v1/test/reset; call worker.fetch(request, env, ctx). isolatedStorage is false and singleWorker true, so use unique ids/emails per test file.
New ids use generateId() (UUIDv7) from backend/src/utils/uuid.ts. D1 conventions: TEXT ISO dates, REAL money, TEXT JSON, INTEGER booleans.

The e2e seed tenant is on pro with 50 max_users (seed-local.mjs); make sure the e2e team spec does not hit the new seat limit: pro included_seats is 15, so check how many users the specs create and, if needed, give the seeded demo tenant a subscription with purchased seats 50 in seed-local (allowed edit: backend/scripts/seed-local.mjs, note it).
Do not touch super-admin or landing here: R112 and R116 switch them to the catalogue endpoints.
ownerDecision: Owner decision 2026-10-14: flat price per agency per year (Basic/Pro/Enterprise) that includes a set number of users, a monthly AI credit allowance and monthly communication allowances; paid add-ons for extra users, AI credit packs and communication credit packs. SMS, WhatsApp, login codes and calls stay INCLUDED in every plan with a predefined monthly cap; at the cap the agency upgrades or buys credits. Communication add-ons are priced at provider unit cost + 20% margin.
